arms.r20fam: own ONE demo (every frame) + pool from the other family members
arms.r20rnd: own ONE demo + pool from as many tasks drawn (seed 1000 + task) from the held-out tasks outside the family, capped at the family pool's size for that target

metrics.experiment: family transfer: do the coarse prototype levels predict which OTHER tasks' data teach a held-out task?

families.rule: average-linkage clustering of the 21 held-out tasks by the mean edit distance between their human demos' collapsed label sequences, cut 0.5 (experiments/r19_families.py; results/robot/r20_families.json)

hypotheses.F1: PRIMARY: r20fam > r20rnd over the 12 targets (240 paired episodes): exact two-sided sign test p < 0.05; the pooled paired difference with the two-level bootstrap reported
hypotheses.F2: secondary: F1 within the 7-task pick-and-place family (140 pairs)
hypotheses.F3: secondary: each pooled arm vs the one-demo LoRA (m3_final tag lora) on the same 12 tasks: does pooling help or hurt at all
hypotheses.descriptive: each vs the task's own practice learners (lora_r16L2, lora_r17bal), which used the target's own practice

metrics.motivation: r19_invariance (commit 7a4839b): task identity lives at the fine levels; the coarse levels are near-invariant within a task and group tasks into verb-like families without language
metrics.pool: per source task: its demo (every frame) + every 5th frame of its successful practice rollouts (m5_practice, m6_round1, m6_round2; init states 0-29) under its own instruction; 1000 frames in all, an equal share per source, uniform subsample; the target's own practice is never used
metrics.reading: F1 passes: the coarse levels predict cross-task transfer (the next step, pre-registered separately, is one adapter per family); F1 fails with both pooled arms alike: any transfer is not family-specific; both below the one-demo LoRA: pooling other tasks hurts
metrics.scoring: init states 30-49, 20 episodes per task and arm (m3_final tags lora_r20fam, lora_r20rnd)
metrics.training: LoRA rank 16 on the action expert, 1000 steps, lr 1e-4, batch 32 = 16 own-demo rows + 16 pool rows, seed 0 (experiments/r20_family.py)
metrics.written_before: any r20 training or rollout (dry runs listed the data only)
